areas.name: importer
areas.invariant: Both sanitised candidate revisions replay byte-equal from the committed PDFs, under the extraction build V01 pinned, and derive the recorded document identity.

areas.name: profile
areas.invariant: An instrument profile resolves to its own rubrics, scorecard and criterion routing, and a criterion cannot be scored under a profile that does not declare it.

areas.name: preflight
areas.invariant: Evidence selection is pinned before an assessor runs: the pack set hashes, the manifest pin binds, and a pack whose anchors do not resolve fails closed.

areas.name: freeze
areas.invariant: The baseline freeze binds what it froze and refuses what it must, and the frozen 74.60 report still passes the gate it was frozen under.

areas.name: regression
areas.invariant: The E4 section golden-set and the E5f rubric lane compare and report as their fixtures specify. Merge-advisory and human-decided by harness/HARNESS.md, so the historical run does not depend on it.

areas.name: comparison
areas.invariant: The ESR comparison replays from the recorded inputs, and a disposition is the operator's decision rather than a measurement the tool makes for them.

areas.name: provenance
areas.invariant: Every recorded identity, hash binding and declaration describes the committed bytes, and the integrity audit reports what it parsed rather than what it assumed.

areas.name: isolation
areas.invariant: The blind lane stays blind: no feedback reaches the assessor, the judge refuses to run inside the repository, and a production run writes no diagnostic copy.

areas.name: scoring
areas.invariant: A criterion score is derived from the draws by the declared arithmetic, and a malformed assessor response is refused and checkpointed rather than scored.

areas.name: ledger
areas.invariant: Claims are extracted, statused and measured from the committed sections, and a status the sources do not support is Unresolved rather than Confirmed.

areas.name: judge
areas.invariant: The judge transport, its response cache and its run log behave offline and deterministically, so a recorded run can be read back.

areas.name: graph
areas.invariant: The development-graph substrate the workspace and candidate records sit on compiles, projects and replays without drift.

areas.name: exclusions
areas.invariant: Every check the harness cannot run is listed with its reason, and neither the disposition table nor this lane can grow an exclusion the other does not know.
